Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Fixed all stackable prizes. Porter now treats the awarded quantity as one prize stack and uses one trade slot, entering the exact quantity through the game's quantity selector when inventory contains a larger stack. This is generic for Cordial, Coke, foods, medicines, crafting materials, and every other stackable item.
